title: Is the state of the economy affecting or changing how you’ll vote in November? Share your story | CNN Politics
text:
Source: CNN

Republicans and Democrats both acknowledge that America is suffering from anaffordability crisis. And while both sides have pledged to provide relief, many people are feeling evenmore squeezedamid therising costofgas,groceries,healthcareand other essentials.

Is the state of the economy prompting you to rethink whom you’ll vote for in your federal and state elections in November?
